nom: TATCHA The Serum Stick Line-Smoothing Treatment & Touch Up Balm

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including winter-dry and dry-patch cases, report near-instant relief of dryness and softer skin, though a few find the balm greasy or too thin once warmed.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin, including sensitivity to fragrance and reactive under-eye areas, report using the stick with zero irritation and value that it is fragrance-free.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin uses it as a spot touch-up on dry cheeks in cold weather with good results.
segments.mature: Reviewers who identify as older or mention aging skin describe it as easy to use, good for creasing and touch-ups, though one notes it does not last very long on the skin.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for fine lines and wrinkles around eyes, mouth and forehead report visible smoothing or plumping, some within days; a couple of reviewers say it made no difference to wrinkles or laugh lines.
concerns.dehydration: Widely reported to relieve dryness, dry patches, cracked skin and dry under-eyes, including nose-area dryness from frequent blowing and post-sunburn skin; one reviewer found it too greasy and another felt it never absorbed into the face.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers report it calmed redness and irritation, including on a dry irritated nose and on eczema-prone skin around the mouth.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema or persistent dry, damaged patches describe fast healing and soothing of compromised skin, with one specifically comparing it favorably to an antiseptic ointment for healing skin they had picked at.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers use it specifically on dry patches or scars and report the marks fading or no longer showing under makeup; no dissent noted for this use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the product caused breakouts and returned it; this is the only account of new blemishes among the reviews.

aspects.libelle: Convenient stick format for travel and touch-ups
Greasy or slow to absorb on face
Works well layered under or over makeup
Can smear or wipe away makeup
Product develops an off smell over time

extraits.titre: PERFECT for very sensitive dry eyes
extraits.texte: I read all of the reviews and saw it was hit or miss I do NOT wear makeup everyday so this has become my go-to for pickup on my undereye My undereye are not in need of firming but they are incredibly dry and sensitive I always wake up with almost crusty lower lash lines! So now I just apply it directly on my eyes under do a few swipes then use my fingers to cover my undereye and crows feet Sometimes I'll pull it to the top eyelid but it's mostly for the bottom If you wear makeup this obviously will not be good to apply multiple times a day This seems to be good for people with dry skin sensitivity to products and fragrance this has none and those not looking specifically for firming

I love this serum stick! I mainly use this for my eyes I have very sensitive skin and I can swipe this over my entire eyelid under my eyes and in my crow feet area with zero irritation I've never found a product that would do that Thank you Tatcha for this wonderful product

I have very dry skin especially in the winter and i found this almost instantly relieves it. I like the formula although it is very pricey so might not purchase again. Could be greasy feeling if you apply too much

I love this product! I always need to have it on me wherever I go I have eczema around my mouth and occasionally get dry spots on my cheeks and sides of my nose I just roll over top of those areas with this serum stick and the dry spots are instantly gone! I also have used this over makeup and it works great over it You just have to tap and blend so that you're not left with an quotemptyquot spot
I have combo skin When spending time in cold and windy weather my cheeks will dry out I started keeping this in my purse for touchups on my dry areas and it keeps my skin so soft

extraits.titre: Made my skin break out still waiting on refund
extraits.texte: The serum stick went on my skin smoothly and felt nice but it made my skin breakout I returned it many weeks ago and I am still waiting on my refund

I bought based on the raving reviews, and my obsession with skincare products lol more so because I have LOVED every Tatcha product I've had. That said, it is a profound game changer if you struggle with seriously dry lips, my lips suffer from drying medications, but I know some skin conditions are such a battle to control. On my face, I never felt like it sunk in, which is probably the greasy feel people got as it thinned out with warmth. No, emulsifying doesnt help either.
